uncertain: Jianpu noteheads on this page are printed × (rhythm only), not scale degrees. Each × is degree 1 with head x; printed 0 is a rest. The degree is not a pitch.
Slur arcs over × are tieToNext. Where the arc accounts for one fewer syllable, the destination has an empty lyric.
Phrase-end down-arrow after the 3-0-1 lick is stroke down on the strings the arrow head crosses (read as 3 and 4).
System 5 measure 3 tab events cover 3 beats; the last beat has no tab glyph.
